messages:
maya: q to group — proposing a unified surface for API errors across chat/completions, embeddings, rerank, and tool-calls. want a minimal GA contract + non-blocking extensions. sketch below, feedback?
kevin: +1 on a single contract. curious which errors we force clients to handle vs optional hints.
lena: important for embeddings — we have long tail timeouts that look like model_unavailable vs rate limit, need distinct codes.
sam: customers asked for clearer retry semantics, esp for function-calls (side effects). they want explicit idempotency hints.
maya: here's a compact proposal (HTTP + body fields):
```
HTTP codes: 200 OK (success), 400 Bad Request (validation), 401 Unauthorized, 403 Forbidden, 404 Not Found, 409 Conflict (version/rollout), 429 Too Many Requests (rate_limit), 424 Failed Dependency (tool-call error), 503 Service Unavailable (model_unavailable/degraded), 500 Internal Error (unknown)
Body: {
  "error": {
    "type": "string" , // machine: validation | rate_limit | model_unavailable | tool_error | quota | internal
    "code": "string", // stable API code e.g. validation.missing_prompt, rate_limit.global
    "message": "human-friendly message",
    "retry_after": "number|null", // seconds suggested
    "help_url": "string|null",
    "idempotency_hint": "string|null" // e.g. idempotent | non-idempotent | conditional
  }
}
```
kevin: that looks good. minor: prefer 409 only for semantic conflicts (model pinned mismatch), 424 seems fine for tool-call partial failure. also recommend an explicit 'fallback_model' field when we auto-route to cheaper model.
lena: +1 on fields. for embeddings add: "partial": boolean and "processed_tokens": number so offline jobs can resume.
arjun: security note — don't return stack traces or jem alloc info. include correlation_id header for traceability. also any help_url must be vetted.
sam: customer ask: for tool/function errors we should clearly separate (a) tool invocation failed (external API) vs (b) tool validation error (bad input). maybe tool_error.{invocation,validation}.
maya: agreed. for GA scope I'm proposing we require: core endpoints (chat, embeddings, rerank) support validation, rate_limit, model_unavailable, internal; function-calls support tool_error with basic idempotency_hint; rollout gating requires SDK changes and docs. advanced fields (partial, processed_tokens, fallback_model) as opt-ins post-GA.
kevin: engineering estimate: runtime change ~2 wks (add structured error envelope + correlation_id headers), SDK updates 1 week per major language, tests + canary 1 week. implies 4 weeks before GA if we prioritize.
arjun: compliance: record full error events into audit log for Private deploys, opt-out for hosted due to PII. need legal signoff for help_url content.
maya: launch criteria checklist (draft):
- API contract published + examples (docs)
- SDKs emit typed exceptions and surface retry_after
- E2E tests for each code path (validation, 429, 503, tool_error)
- Canary in prod with 10% traffic and automatic rollback on error spike
- Customer advisory + migration guide
- Security/legal review done
kevin: add perf guard: error envelope should add < 1% latency at p50. small perf test.
lena: need to capture telemetry: error.type + endpoint + model + region. that drives Optimize recommendations.
sam: ok to scope structured tool_error details (tracebacks, original payload) as redacted in hosted, full details for Dedicated/Private.
maya: operational fallback policy proposal:
- For model_unavailable (503): immediate fallback to pinned compatible model if available, include fallback_model in error body and telemetry
- For rate_limit (429): include quota window and retry_after; SDK auto-backoff for client side
- For validation (400): no retry, explicit field list in message
- For tool_error (424): propagate tool status and an upstream error.id for tracing

kevin: question on semantics: should fallback be automatic for GA or opt-in? auto fallback helps availability but can mask quality regressions.
arjun: recommend opt-out via request header X-Redwood-Fallback: none|auto|audit — default = auto for hosted standard tier, default = none for enterprise Dedicated/Private. this needs product decision.
maya: decision needed: default fallback policy. my call: default = auto for GA to reduce customer downtime, but we must emit a clear signal and allow tenant override. thoughts?
sam: +1 for auto, but add an obvious opt-out and docs. customers that care about quality will opt-out.
lena: add an opt-in for strict validation mode that returns validation errors even for minor coercions.\eoj: deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled: 2026-04-12T10:00Z -> 10% traffic for 48h, auto-rollback on +5% error rate vs baseline.
maya: next steps / owners:
- kevin: runtime changes + test harness (owner)
- lena: telemetry schema + embeddings partial field (owner)
- sam: customer comms + migration guide (owner)
- arjun: security/legal signoff (owner)
- maya: finalize contract doc and publish PR to docs repo (owner)
all: please ack if you can commit to timelines above.
kevin: ack, scheduling now.
lena: ack.
sam: ack — will draft customer note this week.
arjun: ack, will start legal review.
maya: thanks everyone — i'll open a formal RFC and link back to this thread. :thumbsup:
